name: Klaus Richter
bio:
Klaus Richter’s journey into the world of motorsport began unexpectedly during his compulsory military service, where he was assigned to maintain the communication systems for a small rally team. This sparked a lifelong fascination with the intricate technology underpinning racing. Before joining Brasil Racing, Klaus spent years honing his skills at a Viennese tech firm, specializing in network infrastructure. He brings a methodical and thorough approach to his work, ensuring that the team's data flows seamlessly, crucial for real-time analysis and strategic decision-making.

Klaus is known for his relentless pursuit of optimization. He believes that a stable and robust IT infrastructure is as vital to a team's success as a finely tuned engine. His attention to detail is legendary – no server setting goes unexamined, no potential vulnerability unaddressed. At Brasil Racing, he's responsible for maintaining the entire IT ecosystem, from telemetry data acquisition at the track to the cloud-based simulation servers back at headquarters. He takes pride in his ability to anticipate and resolve problems before they impact the team's performance, making him an invaluable asset.

physical.description: A stocky man with a reassuringly calm demeanor and a perpetually focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool in his pocket.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard with loud, clicky keys.
Has a habit of muttering code snippets under his breath when troubleshooting.
